name: focus-panel
description: After each response, a panel above the prompt with what needs you, errors, the next action (with its task id), open to-dos and heads-ups.

useModel.title: Read long responses with Haiku
useModel.description: After a long response, one short Haiku call finds the items the plain rules miss. Costs a few hundred tokens per long response. Off = rules only.

modelMinChars.title: Haiku: minimum response length (characters)
modelMinChars.description: Only responses at least this long are sent to Haiku.
